I just picked up my half moon grey R2 on Friday and turned in my gen 2 R1S (like you, a stopgap lease, but I only did 2 years). So far… I love it. There’s a bunch of stuff missing that I’m hopeful is added REALLY soon. The biggest is probably no voice command at all. I just finally got use to going from saying ‘Alexa’ to ‘Hey Rivian’ and now I’m even further back. Also, no YouTube or Googlecast, which makes the car feel sort of naked, no SiriusXM app, no garage door control (which I know is due in the next update)and just an overall getting to know the car all over again. I know everything the car does, a lot of it is just done differently or in a new place. The Halo Wheels are still a learning process and the biggest surprise/adjustment is how sensitive they are and how little you have do engage them. Rather than pushing the wheels left or right to make selections, it’s actually more of a minor swipe where you barely touch the wheels… quickly brushing your thumb over the wheel left or right. They’re surprisingly sensitive. 

The biggest surprise to me is how quiet and smooth the ride is compared to my R1S and just how much I enjoy driving with the back glass down. Even on the highway at 70+mph, the open back makes almost NO NOISE. 

But even though it’s only been a few days, I’m really loving the R2 and the transition from the slightly larger R1 has been negligible. Can’t wait to see more content from you when you get yours.
